title: Carry the confirmed-model Stage 2 goal into the paper-walk prototype
summary: Record the explicit goal to continue until the existing Stage 2 requirements are satisfied on the confirmed mass-corrected robot, including actual paper-informed PPO and an actual Isaac policy video. Add maintained prototype ownership for the nine top-level paper-walk modules while preserving the original 73 source classifications and excluding the prototype tests directory from tool inventory. Document the observation-history, velocity-estimator and motion-prior adaptation, its kinematic-reference limitations, same-source native admission and unchanged qualification gates. Cover the associated review, prior and execution evidence without claiming successful native admission, completed PPO or Stage 2 acceptance.
next: Continue the authorized goal through matching native admission, real learning, held-out evaluation and actual policy recording; only the existing complete Stage 2 requirements and scoped human visual acceptance can satisfy the goal.
